name: TreePRO
description: From the inventors of the world's most advanced slackline pulley system comes the best slackline tree protection any park ranger could imagine. The innovative design with integrated load-distributors made of carbon fibre allow you to slack on any tree as long as its diameter is big enough. But even more: It allows you to use any kind of anchor sling you like. You want to use that ultra lightweight dyneema slings? Good to go: TreePRO allows you to use them on trees because it distributes the load even of the thinnest anchor slings to a maximum area at the tree. This effectively prevents tree damage as never seen before. TreePRO is made of very flexible foam, extremely robust Cordura 1000 den Nylon and carbon fibre load distributors.

name: Tree-Shirt  L TreePro
description: The largest version of tree protection in our Tree-shirt family: 250 cm x 25 cm. Designed for longline usage and really helpful when rigging slackline on wide trees. Four support loops for spansets make them stay in place, preventing anchor from sliding down before tensioning the line. Each loop allows to pass the knot of two 1T spansets.

name: TreeHugger Classic
description: Felt tree-protection sling. A high-quality felt tree protector that keeps trees safe from slackline abrasion. Great for park lines and padding highline anchors. Four webbing straps along its length hold your sling in place while you wrap the anchor.

name: TreeHugger Cosmic
description: Heavy-duty felt tree protector. The bigger brother to our Classic TreeHugger: thicker, more durable felt with cutouts down its length for weight savings. Built for bigger trees and larger anchor materials, with webbing tabs to hold your slings and Velcro so you can link several together.

name: Tree-Shirt M TreePro
description: Tree-shirt tree protection in medium size 150 cm x 20 cm. Designed to be used with all kinds of slackline kits. Large velcro ensures firm positioning of the treepro and allows connecting one to another. Two support loops make setting up slackline easier, preventing anchor from sliding down before tensioning the line.

name: Treepro XL
description: Protecting trees is responsible slackline etiquette and is always recommended when setting up at home or public places. TREEPRO XL makes it easy with two pieces of self-closing padding to simply wrap each tree prior to putting up the slackline. More than twice the size of the original, XL takes on any size tree and holds the line in place while setting up.

name: Tree Pro
description: Protecting trees is responsible slackline etiquette and is always recommended when setting up at home or public places. The TREEPRO design makes it easy with two pieces of self-closing, durable padding that also protect the slackline from abrasion and fraying to extend the life of your gear.

name: TreeProtection Set
notes: Checked against the live page 2026-10-08: felt fabric only, 240 cm x 16 cm x 5 mm, 1.8 l, 340 g, Velcro fastener, no sling loops; 40 EUR for the set (out of stock that day). Grey felt with an embroidered logo. Formerly named 'Slackline Tree Protection Set' here, and shown with a photo of the white-edged TreeProtector 3.0, which is a different product.
description: With a length of 240 cm, this SLACKTIVITY TreeProtection Set is the longest on the market. Thanks to the practical Velcro fastener and the felt fabric, the tree protection is very easy to install around the tree. Due to a certain rigidity of the tree protection, the pressure from the tree sling is distributed well over the felt cover on the tree bark and thus protects the tree optimally.

name: TreeProtector 2.0
description: The SLACKTIVITY Treeprotector is the longest one on the market! And maybe even the most robust one.
notes: Split from the old #11 'TreeProtection Set | V2' on 2026-10-08, which mixed this product's name and photo with the 3.0's specs and #10's URL and description. Slacktivity's own comparison photo (https://slacktivity.ch/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/slackline-baumschutz-vergleich.jpg) labels this all-brown felt roll 'TreeProtector 2.0'. Maker's pages: SKU TREE (single, 19.90 CHF) / TREE-2 (pair, 38 CHF; 29.95 EUR on slacktivity.com 2016 and 2019); felt front, polyester back, tear strength >10 kN, 240 x 12.5 cm x 3 mm, 0.5 l, 340 g each (680 g a pair), Velcro closure; https://web.archive.org/web/20160628012755/http://www.slacktivity.com:80/tree-protectors, https://web.archive.org/web/20190720165125/https://www.slacktivity.ch/de/treeprotection. Replaced by the TreeProtector 3.0 (SKU TREE-3) in late 2019. Historic, though slacktivity.de still listed a 'Baumschutz' with this photo at 15 EUR in 2026 (https://slacktivity.de/products/baumschutz).

name: Tree Protection | 3L
description: The strongest and longest tree protectors on the market, whit loops.
notes: Checked against the live page 2026-10-08: felt front, polyester back, tear strength >10 kN, three 8 cm fixing loops, 240 cm x 13.5 cm x 3 mm, 1.0 l, 332 g; 23 EUR single, 44 EUR pair. The looped version of the TreeProtector 3.0 / V3.

name: Tree Protection XL
description: The SLACKLINE TREE PROTECTION XL, with a length of 2m serves as a perfect protection for bigger trees for longer and heavier Slackline or Longline set-ups

name: Tree-Shirt S TreePro
description: Small size, multi-purpose tree protection. Perfect for wrapping various elements of your slackline setup like spansets, ratchets or webbing, to prevent abrasion, hitting or other damage.

name: Tree Pad
description: Absolutely necessary equipment for every slackliner simply because trees are your friends.

name: Tree Eco
description: The "TreEco" is a tree protection but also a protection for your webbing and slings. Very easy to set up, there is a hook and loop (like a Velcro) to fix the protection around the tree. They will extend the life span of your equipment which is a good thing and also protect the bark (and cambium) of the tree.

name: Treewear XL - Edition
description: GIBBON TreeWear XL is a simple, versatile way to protect both trees and SlackLines from abrasion. Made from durable black felt with practical Velcro attachment, it wraps easily around trees or anchor points. Extend the life of your webbing while supporting more sustainable slacklining. TreeWear XL is compatible with all GIBBON SlackLine sets and is a must-have for every slackliner.

name: Tree Protectors
description: Tree Protectors are an important part of your slackline kit, not only do they protect the trees but they protect your slings from abrasion and damage. Handy velcro strips easily secure the Tree Protector to the tree and hold your slings in place.
notes: Sold as a 2-pack; weight is 2x180g for the pair.

name: "Boomslang" Tree Protectors
description: Tree protection for slacklining, longlining and highline abrasion protection. Protects the trees and extends the life of your gear.
notes: Sold as a pair. Included velcro straps join the two protectors together for larger trees or boulders — they do not carry a sling.

name: Tree Pro
description: Tree protection cut from heavy outdoor carpeting rather than felt, for more durability against bark and against wear on the webbing. Sold as a set of two.
notes: Manufacturer specs (yogaslackers.com): 6 ft (183 cm) long, 6 in (15 cm) wide; no weight or thickness published. Every order is a pair, and each piece carries a strip of velcro to hold it in place — the velcro joins the protector around the tree, it does not carry a sling.

name: TreePlus 2.0
notes: Maker's page (Wayback 2011-07-22): synthetic fibre mat 3 mm, 2 m x 18 cm, trees up to 2.5 m circumference, 600 g per pair, rotating belt with YKK buckles, 3 Clip-Lock sling loops (2 sliding, 1 fixed); red, green or black; made in the EU. 29.95 € (pair).
description: A proper treeprotection is mandatory while mounting a slackline to a tree. This prevents the tree from long-term damage and creates acceptance for slacklining in public parks and forests. For this reason, we have designed in 2008 our functional treeprotection TreePlus. In addition to the protection function it provides many advantages, which make a slackline setup much more comfortable. Our protection classic TreePlus, now in the updated and improved version offers even more functionality and comfort. Thanks to the optimized sling loops with a fast clip-lock, the setup is faster and more variable.

name: TreeBuddies
notes: Maker's page (German only, Wayback 2010-07-17): Landcruising's basic tree protector, same 3 mm synthetic felt as TreePlus, 160 cm x 14 cm, trees up to 2 m circumference, 270 g per pair, sewn YKK Velcro closure plus 2 extra-long Velcro straps to hold the tree sling; red/yellow or black/grey; made in the EU. 12.95 € (pair). Included in the Starter Flex, Starter Aerial and Cruiser kits.

name: Tree Protection Small
notes: Maker's page (Wayback 2025-01-21): polypropylene felt 5 mm, 100 x 15 cm, no loops, 100 g, trees up to 0.9 m (combinable), blue or orange, sold singly. 6.50 €. The old Shopware shop's 'Baumschutz S' is the same product.
description: Small 1 m long and 15 cm high slackline tree protection without loops. A thick polypropylene felt is used as the material. A wide Velcro strip guarantees a firm fit on the tree trunk and with its help, several tree protectors can be attached to each other to carefully protect even very large trees from abrasion. The AkiSlack logo is elaborately embroidered and rounds off the functional overall picture.

name: Tree Protection Medium
notes: Maker's page (Wayback 2024-09-19): polypropylene felt 5 mm, 150 x 20 cm, 2 sewn sling loops, 170 g, trees up to 1.3 m, black, made in Poland, sold singly. 9.50 €. Included in the Aki Starter kit (#13).
description: Slackline tree protection medium size 1.5 m long and 20 cm wide. The Aki Tree Protection Medium has 2 sewn loops for attaching a tree sling. A thick polypropylene felt is used as the material. A wide, firmly sewn-on Velcro strip guarantees a tight fit on the tree trunk and with its help, several tree protectors can also be attached to one another in order to carefully protect trees with a larger trunk circumference from abrasion. The AkiSlack logo is elaborately embroidered and rounds off the functional overall picture.

name: Tree Protection XL
notes: Maker's page (Wayback 2025-01-21): polypropylene felt 5 mm, 250 x 25 cm, 4 sewn sling loops, 360 g, trees up to 2.3 m, black, sold singly. 14.50 €. The photo file is named 'Baumschutz-Large', which supports the old shop's 'Tree Protection Large' being this product.
description: Extra large 2.5 m long and 25 cm high slackline tree protection with 4 sewn loops for attachment of tree slings. A thick polypropylene felt is used as the material. A wide Velcro strip guarantees a firm fit on the tree trunk and with its help, several tree protectors can be attached to each other to carefully protect even very large trees from abrasion. The AkiSlack logo is elaborately embroidered and rounds off the functional overall picture.

name: TreeProtector 3.0
description: Slackline Tree Protection Set – 3.0 is the longest one on the market! It allows you to protect trees and gear on large anchor points.
notes: Split from the old #11 'TreeProtection Set | V2' on 2026-10-08 (see TreeProtector 2.0). Felt with a white polyester edge; the comparison photo labels it 'TreeProtector 3.0', and slacktivity.ch now sells it as 'TreeProtector | V3' (SKU TREE-3). Introduced around November 2019 (first capture https://web.archive.org/web/20191113141955/https://www.slacktivity.ch/de/treeprotection-3-set), whose page says version 3.0 cut the pack size, widened it to 13.5 cm and made it a little lighter. Specs from the live .ch page (German): felt front, polyester back, tear strength >10 kN, 240 x 13.5 cm x 3 mm, 1.0 l, 315 g; 23 CHF single, 43 CHF a pair. The description is the English blurb from slacktivity.com's 2021 page 'Slackline Tree Protection Set | 3.0' (https://web.archive.org/web/20210512045326/https://slacktivity.com/shop/slackline-tree-protection-set-3-0/, 39.95 EUR a set), whose spec list repeated the 2.0's 12.5 cm / 340 g and is not used. The looped version is Tree Protection | 3L (#12). Marked inactive 2026-10-08: the .ch page still lists it but shows it out of stock ('Nicht vorrätig', schema.org OutOfStock); the looped 3L (#12) is what slacktivity.com sells.
